newsitem.title: FINLAND: EMU TO ENHANCE FINNISH ECONOMIC CREDIBILITY - EVA.
newsitem.headline: EMU TO ENHANCE FINNISH ECONOMIC CREDIBILITY - EVA.

text.p: Economic and monetary union will bring both stability and credibility to the Finnish economy, the Centre for Finnish Business and Policy Studies (EVA) said in a report on Friday.

"The government's target of Finland being among the first to join the third stage of EMU is well founded on the thought that it will further strengthen the credibility development (of the economy)," EVA said.
"The EMU convergence criteria are in fact criteria for a healthy economy," it added.
Low inflation and interest rates, a stable currency and keeping the public defict to GDP in a tight grip were conditions for economic well-being, EVA said.
